bugClass.title: Git archive exceeds a command's output limit
bugClass.cause: A caller captures an entire Git archive on standard output through a bounded command runner, so a repository with a larger tracked tree fails before the archive can be consumed.
bugClass.criteria: The call exports a tree as an archive and collects the archive bytes in a bounded command result. Calls using Git's --output option or piping to a file or extractor avoid the failure.
